script.title: LUNCH, PLEASE?
script.scene_zh: 辦公樓下 · 相約午餐
script.story_hook: Two desks apart. One brave lunch invite.
script.intro_zh: 兩張桌子之隔，一趟勇敢的午餐邀約。
script.welcome_en: Today a new team member asks a coworker to lunch. Listen for plans!
script.welcome_zh: 今天新同事邀資深同事吃午餐。注意聽約時間的句子！
script.outro: That's how one invite becomes a weekly tradition. Awesome job!
script.outro_zh: 一個邀約就這樣變成每週傳統。表現太棒了！
script.practice_intro_en: Now repeat the lunch invitation phrases with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟我重唸邀吃午餐常用句。
script.char_a_description: a perky mixed-race woman in her early thirties with shoulder-length curly brown hair, wearing a teal cardigan over a striped tee, high-waisted dark jeans, red canvas sneakers, and small stud earrings
script.char_b_description: a tall Indian man in his late forties with slicked-back gray-flecked hair and a thick black mustache, wearing rectangular glasses, a beige long kurta shirt, dark slacks, and brown loafers

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey Dev, busy? Quick question, maybe two.
dialogue.phonetic: /heɪ dɛv bizi kwɪk ˈkwɛstʃən meɪbi tu/
dialogue.zh: 戴夫，忙嗎？有個小問題，也許兩個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hey Nia! Not busy. What's up?
dialogue.phonetic: /heɪ ˈniːə nɑt bizi wʌts ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 妮雅你好！不忙，怎麼了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, lunch? This week, I mean. Sometime.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ lʌntʃ ðɪs wik aɪ min ˈsʌmˌtaɪm/
dialogue.zh: 就是……想約午餐。這週，我是說，找個時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Today, you mean? Say less. I'm starving.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ ju min seɪ lɛs aɪm stɑrvɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 你是說今天？別多說了，我餓扁了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Bold. But yes, today works great.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ boʊld bʌt jɛs təˈdeɪ wɜrks ɡreɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哈！好直接。不過沒錯，今天很棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where to? I'm easy. I just hate lines.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr tu aɪm ˈizi aɪ dʒʌst heɪt laɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 去哪裡？我很好養，只是很討厭排隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: New Thai place opened by the bank.
dialogue.phonetic: /nu ˈtaɪ pleɪs ˈoʊpənd baɪ ðə bæŋk/
dialogue.zh: 銀行旁新開了一家泰國館子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ooh, heard about that. What time works?
dialogue.phonetic: /u hɜrd əˈbaʊt ðæt wʌt taɪm wɜrks/
dialogue.zh: 噢，聽過這家。幾點方便？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noon? I've got a two o'clock thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /nun aɪv ɡɑt ə tu əˈklɑk θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 中午可以嗎？我兩點有事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noon's good. Wait — do you eat meat?
dialogue.phonetic: /nunz ɡʊd weɪt du ju it mit/
dialogue.zh: 中午沒問題。等等，你吃肉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Me? Yes. Do you not?
dialogue.phonetic: /mi jɛs du ju nɑt/
dialogue.zh: 我？吃啊。你不吃？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Vegetarian since twenty. Old news, don't laugh.
dialogue.phonetic: /vɛdʒəˈtɛriən sɪns ˈtwɛnti oʊld nuz doʊnt læf/
dialogue.zh: 我吃素從二十歲就開始。老新聞啦，別笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Laugh? I respect it. Big commitment.
dialogue.phonetic: /læf aɪ rɪˈspɛkt ɪt bɪɡ kəˈmɪtmənt/
dialogue.zh: 我怎麼會笑？我很佩服，這超需要毅力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks! Their veggie curry's famous, apparently.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks ðɛr ˈvɛdʒi ˈkɜri feɪməs əˈpɛrəntli/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！他們家的素咖哩據說很有名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Oh, one thing — shellfish allergy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt oʊ wʌn θɪŋ ˈʃɛlfɪʃ ˈælɜrdʒi/
dialogue.zh: 太完美。喔，還有件事——我對貝類海鮮過敏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Serious?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪriəs/
dialogue.zh: 嚴重嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eyelids swell up like balloons. Very annoying.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaɪˌlɪdz swɛl ʌp laɪk bəˈlunz ˈvɛri əˈnɔɪɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 眼瞼會腫成氣球那種，很惱人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noted. We'll skip anything with shrimp paste.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtɪd wil skɪp ˈɛniˌθɪŋ wɪð rɪmp peɪst/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，我們避開所有蝦醬料理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're handling this better than my last team.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊrz ˈhændlɪŋ ðɪs ˈbɛtɚ ðæn maɪ læst tim/
dialogue.zh: 你比我上一家公司的人好相處太多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, what happened?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ wʌt ˈhæpənd/
dialogue.zh: 哈，之前發生過什麼事？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ordered me soup. From the shrimp bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔrdərd mi sup fɚm ðə rɪmp boʊl/
dialogue.zh: 他們替我點湯，居然是從蝦鍋盛的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oof. Lucky you're brave enough to ask again.
dialogue.phonetic: /uf ˈlʌki jʊrz breɪv ɪˈnʌf tə əsk əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 嘖，還好你敢再次開口約人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, you seem chill. Plus, I must eat lunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ju sim tʃɪl plʌs aɪ mʌst it lʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，你給人輕鬆的感覺，而且人總得吃午餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: High bar, honestly. Shall we walk?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ bɑr ˈɑnəstli ʃæl wi wɔk/
dialogue.zh: 這理由說得好。我們走路去？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six minutes. I checked already. Scientific.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈmɪnɪts aɪ tʃɛkt ɔlˈrɛdi ˌsaɪənˈtɪfɪk/
dialogue.zh: 六分鐘，我早查過了，很科學。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Overkill. Oh no. Is that a line?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊvɚˌkɪl oʊ noʊ ɪz ðæt ə laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 太誇張。噢不會吧，那是隊伍嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yep. It's Tuesday lunch. Of course.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ɪts ˈtuzˌdeɪ lʌntʃ ʌv kɔrs/
dialogue.zh: 對啊，週二的午餐時間，當然要排隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How long, you think?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ ju θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 你估要排多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hostess said fifteen, maybe twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhoʊstɪs sɛd ˌfɪfˈtin meɪbi ˈtwɛnti/
dialogue.zh: 外場說十五分，也許二十分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty kills my noon. We'd rush everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti kɪlz maɪ nun wiːd rʌʃ ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘就毀了我的午休，什麼都要趕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True. Plan B? There's a noodle bar next door.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru plæn bi ðɛrz ə ˈnudəl bɑr nɛkst dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 說得對。備案呢？隔壁有一家麵店。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hand-pulled noodles? I've been dying to try that place.
dialogue.phonetic: /hænd pʊld ˈnudəlz aɪv bɪn ˈdaɪɪŋ tə traɪ ðæt pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 手工拉麵？那家我做夢都想試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Join the club. Walk over now?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒɔɪn ðə klʌb wɔk ˈoʊvɚ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 同求。現在就過去？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lead off. I'll text Priya to save seats.
dialogue.phonetic: /lid ɔf aɪl tɛkst ˈpriːjə tə seɪv sits/
dialogue.zh: 你帶路，我傳訊叫普里雅幫我們佔位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who's Priya? Also on our team?
dialogue.phonetic: /huz ˈpriːjə ˈɔlsoʊ ɑn ɑːr tim/
dialogue.zh: 普里雅是誰？也是我們組的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Front desk. Lovely, loud, eats free.
dialogue.phonetic: /frʌnt dɛsk ˈlʌvli laʊd its fri/
dialogue.zh: 櫃台那位。人超好、超大聲、吃飯不付錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sounds like my kind of lunch crew.
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz laɪk maɪ kaɪnd ʌv lʌntʃ kru/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來是我喜歡的飯局成員。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She's coming. Two minutes, she says.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃiz ˈkʌmɪŋ tu ˈmɪnɪts ʃi sɛz/
dialogue.zh: 她說兩分鐘就到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Hey, can I ask a small favor?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt heɪ kan aɪ æsk ə smɔl ˈfeɪvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。對了，我能提個小請求嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shoot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃut/
dialogue.zh: 你說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mind if we split the bill? Budget's tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪnd ɪf wi splɪt ðə bɪl bʌdʒɪts taɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我們各付各的好嗎？預算有點緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Absolutely. You just joined. No shame, ever.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌæbsəˈlutli ju dʒʌst dʒɔɪnd noʊ ʃeɪm ˈɛvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以。你才剛來，這半點都不丟臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for saying it. I needed that.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɚ ˈseɪɪŋ ɪt aɪ ˈnidɪd ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你說出來，我正需要這句話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any day. Also, my treat next week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛnɪ deɪ ˈɔlsoʊ maɪ trit nɛkst wik/
dialogue.zh: 別客氣。而且下週輪到我請客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Oh — a table just opened up!
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn oʊ ə ˈteɪbəl dʒʌst oʊpənd ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 說定。喔——剛空出一個位子！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sprint or power walk?
dialogue.phonetic: /sprɪnt ɔr ˈpaʊɚ wɔk/
dialogue.zh: 衝刺還是快走？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Power walk. I'm professional, remember?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpaʊɚ wɔk aɪm prəˈfɛʃənəl rɪˈmɛmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 快走。我很講究專業，記得吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Extra spicy okay? Their chili's no joke.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛkstrə ˈspaɪsi oˈkeɪ ðɛr ˈtʃɪliz noʊ dʒoʊk/
dialogue.zh: 特辣可以嗎？他們家的辣可不是開玩笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Medium only for me. My stomach's dramatic.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmidɪəm ˈoʊnli fɚ mi maɪ ˈstʌməkz drəˈmætɪk/
dialogue.zh: 我只要小辣，我的胃很愛演。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine's worse. We'll look brave and cry.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪnz wɜrs wil lʊk breɪv ænd kraɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我的更糟。我們到時候邊流淚邊裝勇敢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! That's already teamwork.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðæts ɔlˈrɛdi ˈtimˌwɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 哈！這已經算是團隊精神了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, seats by the window. Priya's fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk sits baɪ ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ ˈpriːjəz fæst/
dialogue.zh: 你看，窗邊有位子。普里雅動作真快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's not here. She just knew.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃiz nɑt hɪr ʃi dʒʌst nju/
dialogue.zh: 人還沒到。她只是預感特別準。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Genius lady. Bowls for three?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʒinjəs ˈleɪdi baʊlz fɚ θri/
dialogue.zh: 天才姊姊。要點三碗嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Make mine beef, medium, no cilantro.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪk maɪn bif ˈmidɪəm noʊ sɪˈlæntroʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我的要牛肉、小辣、不要香菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cilantro? You're wrong. But noted.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪˈlæntroʊ jʊrz rɔŋ bʌt ˈnoʊtɪd/
dialogue.zh: 不吃香菜？你錯了。但我記下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll fight you after eating.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl faɪt ju ˈæftɚ ˈitɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 吃過飯我再跟你辯論。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring it. Lunch friends now, officially.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ɪt lʌntʃ frɛndz naʊ əˈfɪʃəli/
dialogue.zh: 放馬過來。我們現在正式是飯友了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every Thursday, then. Calendar says yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri ˈθɜrzˌdeɪ ðɛn ˈkæləndɚ sɛz jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 那就每週四。我行事曆說沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Calendar agreed. Grab the seats before they're gone!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæləndɚ əˈɡrid ɡræb ðə sits bɪˈfɔr ðɛrz ɡɑn/
dialogue.zh: 行事曆也點頭。快坐，不然位子就沒了！

script.youtube_description:
新進公司，想邀同事吃午餐，英文該怎麼開口才自然？
這一集是60句完整的約午餐對話：輕鬆邀約、飲食禁忌、時間安排、排隊備案、禮貌分帳，全部實戰。

你會學到：
・ 輕鬆邀約的說法（So, lunch? This week, I mean. Sometime.）
・ 過敏與吃素的交代（shellfish allergy、Vegetarian since twenty.）
・ 禮貌談錢的說法（Mind if we split the bill? Budget's tight.）

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，不用背，多聽就會用。

訂閱我們，讓你的辦公室午餐再也不孤單！
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_en:
You're new at work and want a lunch buddy - without being awkward. Here's the exact English.
This episode is one full 60-line invite: asking, dietary needs, lines at restaurants, plan B noodle shops, and splitting the bill.

You will hear:
・ casual, natural invitations
・ allergy and vegetarian vocabulary
・ money talk that stays polite

The second half is line-by-line listening and repeat-after-me practice. No memorizing - just listen, and it sticks.

Subscribe for more everyday English for office life!
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
剛到新公司，午餐時間一個人坐，要不要開口邀同事？
用英文約午餐，會顯得太刻意嗎？
這一集帶大家走進週中午的辦公樓下，新同事和資深同事從一張桌子聊到一碗拉麵。

你會聽到：
🍜「So, lunch? This week, I mean. Sometime.」自然又害羞的邀約
🥜「Perfect. Oh, one thing — shellfish allergy。」交代過敏的句型
⏰「Twenty kills my noon. We'd rush everything。」時間不夠的婉拒
🧾「Mind if we split the bill? Budget's tight。」禮貌談錢的說法

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧 60句約午餐對話，一句一句慢速重複，讓句子自然進到嘴裡。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

願你的辦公室午餐，永遠有人同桌。
